answers.core: Cannot be implemented outside of core as far as I can tell.
answers.workaround:
I have not been able to find a workaround.

The docs indicate that calling `open` on the dock when the `default_slot` is `DOCK_SLOT_NONE` will open the dock as floating.  I tried to hack a method together to make it floating, but I was unsuccessful.  The `await` calls were a shot in the dark.  They didn't help.
```gdscript
extends EditorDock
...
func force_windowed():
	close()
	await get_tree().process_frame
	default_slot = EditorPlugin.DOCK_SLOT_NONE
	await get_tree().process_frame
	open()
```

title: Add ability to change EditorDock slot/floating via code (at least floating).
